diagnosis: The 403 error occurs because the Audit Log feature is not included in the Startup plan tier. Current audit logs are only available on Standard and Premium support tiers.
reply: It looks like the audit log endpoint is returning a 403 error because the Audit Log feature is not part of the Startup plan your account is on. To use the audit log, you would need to upgrade to a plan that includes this feature. If you have any questions about upgrading or about which other services are available for your tier, let me know and I can point you in the right direction.
